cells.quote: Given that motivation drives effort (see above), effort investment, which should also be reflected in how much students regulate their learning, should be highest for medium-difficulty tasks.
cells.note: The commentary presents this as a theoretical prediction derived from Atkinson’s (1957) achievement-motivation theory, not as a new empirical finding.

cells.quote: Seufert (2018, 2020) propose that there is a u-shaped relationship between task difficulty and students’ regulatory activities (see Seufert et al., 2024, for corroborating evidence). Hence, medium-difficulty tasks are a sweet spot, where effective learning tasks place.
